Title: Simple Mix & Match
Content: Objective CLO-SET Simple Mix &amp Match is a feature that allows you to play around with your garments by coordinating them as a top and a bottom. You can easily Mix &amp Match' 3D items in real-time. Communicate with your partners, Share ideas, and Make final decisions for your outfits. How to use Mix &amp Match Tips Details 1) How to use Mix&ampMatch 1. Move the Content you want to Mix&ampMatch to the same Assortment room *You can only select the 3D Contents in the same Assortment room from where you entered the Mix&ampMatch page. 2. Multi-select the contents by clicking the check box at the top-left side of the respective content 3. Click the MIX AND MATCH Icon 4. Select the Category (Top/Bottom) 5. Load your items by drag-and-dropping one content from each category(Top/Bottom) into the viewer. 2) Tips We recommend using contents that are created with consistent avatars and poses for more promising outcomes. There is no limitation in categorization. Hence, you may categorize a coat as a Top and a dress as a Bottom to try Mix &amp Match.

Title: Create Space
Content: Objective CLO-SET provides a tailored Space structure tailored for Fashion industry. Start adding new Spaces to build a unique structure that meets your Company's needs. CLO-SET Space Hierarchy Creating each Space Details 1) CLO-SET Space Hierarchy CLO-SET Group consists of Spaces from Company all the way to Workroom &amp Assortment. Workroom is where you can directly upload your Contents and Assets. You may also manage permission by Space. Learn more HERE. 2) Creating each Space Creating Company Go to 'Companies' and click icon to create the Company. You can select the Company picture, color and name. Click 'Confirm' to create the Company. Creating Brand Go to 'Brands' and click icon to create the Brand. You can select the Brand picture, color and name. Click 'Confirm' to create the Brand. Creating Season Once you enter into the specific Brand page, click icon to create the Season. You can type the name of the Season and click 'Confirm' to create the Season. Creating Workroom/Assortment Once you enter into the specific Season page, click icon to create the Workroom or Assortment. You can type the name of the Workroom/Assortment and click 'Confirm' to create the Space. Creating Sub-workroom You can create multiple sub-workrooms under Workroom. Once you enter into the specific Workroom page, click icon and click 'Confirm' to create the sub-workroom.

Title: Invite/Share
Content: Invite your team members, or share your work to your partners. Understand the difference and learn how to start collaborating. Objective Invite vs. Share Invite Share Accessible People Public Content Permission Management Details 1) Invite vs. Share There are 4 Permission Level in CLO-SET. You may either Invite your teammates as Admin or Collaborator, or Share your work to Editors or Viewers. Learn more on CLO-SET Permission HERE. Invite Admin or Collaborators Share to Editor or Viewers Add Group Operator 2) Invite to Company / Brand Company Admin has the authority to invite specific users to Company. Company and Brand Admin have the authority to invite specific users to Brand. 1. Enter the email address of the user you wish to invite 2. Select permission (Admin/Collaborator) 3. Click 'Invite' *[Changes on Invite] From May 2024 Prior to May 2024 Recipient is added to the Group and granted access automatically, and do NOT need to accept the invite. Recipient must first accept the invite to access the Space. 3) Share Share Workroom / Assortment / Content Editors or above can share Workroom/Assortment/Content with others. From Content page, click on 'Share' tab on your far right. From Workroom/Assortment, use the right pane. 1. Enter the email address of the user you wish to invite 2. Select permission (Can Edit/Can View) 3. (optional) For Viewers, you may add download/upload permission 4. Click 'Share' *Please be cautious when sharing your Content. 4) Accessible People At the bottom of the Share Tab, you may view the full list of Accessible People to each Space/Content. This includes not only the people shown on the above list, but all users who with access. *For example, from Workroom, you can only invite Editor/Viewers, but anyone with Admin/Collaborator permission on the upper level Spaces can also access the Workroom. 5) Public Content You may publicize your Content to share with a broader audience. There are 2 options: 1. Embed the 3D Viewer to your own website - NO CLO-SET account required to view 2. Share with Link - Anyone with the link can view -please be cautious as this will make your Workroom/Content Public. That is, anyone with the link can view your Content, and share it with others without a limit. 6) Permission Management for Group Admin / Group Operator To view the full list of Group members and manage Permission, visit 'Permission Management' from the Console tab. Find out more details on Permission Management HERE.

Title: Content Copy
Content: Objective You can copy a Content to a different Workroom, or within the same Workroom. When Contents are copied, it will bring with it all of the details within. Content Copy Copy as Linked Content Details 1) Content Copy Enter the Workroom in which the desired Content is located. Select the Content Select 'Copy' from the floating menu Enter the name of the Copy Select Copy Type, and select the Workroom to generate the Copy in To make it a Linked Content, turn on the option 2)Copy as Linked Content Turn on 'Make a Child Content' option Enter a Memo about the Child Content, and click 'OK' Your will see a Child Content has been created at the selected Workroom From the Parent Content, click on the 'Linked Content' button to view the full list. *When you create a copy within the same Company space as the original file, Workflow &amp Category information will be copied as well. If not, it will be reset. *When you multi-copy and create Child Content, each copy will be linked to the same garment only. For example, if you select garment A,B,C and copy them with Child Content option, garment A will be linked to the copy of garment A only.

Title: Console - Permission Management
Content: Permission: Group Admin, Group Operator Objective Access Admin Console by clicking icon on your CLO-SET dashboard. Admin Console shows the Group summary, Billing, Statistics, Activity Log, Settings, and Developer Page. On the Settings tab, you may review details on your billing history, invoice, and user history. Search Change Permission Remove Access Details 1) Search 1. Search by keyword (Name &amp Email) 2. Search by space (including subspace is available) *Search filter is not provided to Group Operator. Only Group Admin can use the 'Space' filter. 3. Search by content 2) Change Permission 1. Collaborator &gt Admin / Admin &gt Collaborator Hover mouse &gt click &gt click on change to Admin/collaborator 2. Editor &gt Viewer / Viewer &gt Editor Hover mouse &gt Click &gt Click on change &gt click the drop-down box &gt change permission 3) Remove Access 1. Delete user - Single/multi select to remove the entire access. 2. Remove access by space - Hover mouse &gt Click &gt Click remove

Title: New User Tutorial: CLO-SET in 5 minutes!
Content: Welcome to CLO-SET! We're thrilled to see you join us. To help with your onboarding, we've prepared quick tutorial videos on how to effectively use CLO-SET. Watch the clips below and try it yourself on your CLO-SET dashboard! Click here to download sample files

Title: Console - Group Settings
Content: Permission: Group Admin, Group Operator Objective Access Admin Console by clicking icon on your CLO-SET dashboard. Admin Console shows the Group summary, Billing, Statistics, Activity Log, Settings, and Developer Page. On the Settings tab, you may review details on your billing history, invoice, and user history. Group Settings Details 1) Group Settings 1. Change your Group name by double-clicking on the field. 2. Change the color of your group's icon () or select a thumbnail image for your group (). 3. Add a Group Operator to your group. Group Operators can ONLY access the Admin Console tab.

Title: Embed Viewer
Content: Objective Embed Viewer allows you to share the 3D view with the public crowd. Share the link or embed the CLO-SET 3D viewer in external websites. No CLO-SET account is required to view the Embed Viewer. Launch Embed Viewer Share via Link or QR code Embed to External Website Details 1) Launch Embed Viewer 1. From the 3D Viewer, click on the Embed button at the bottom right corner 2. Click 'OK' on the pop-up modal. **Please be mindful that launching the Embed Viewer will convert your Content to a Public status. Anyone with the link will be able to view the Content. Be ware of security implications of Embed Viewer. 3. Select show options, logo type, and URL Show Options Show and Hide UI: on the top left of the Viewer. Viewers can turn on/off the avatar and garment. Colorway: on the bottom of the Viewer. Select whether or not to provide Colorway selection option. Deselect to provide only the Colorway shown on the Viewer. Logo: on the top right of Viewer. Select a CLO-SET logo or remove watermark. URL Type Link &amp QR Code: Share the Viewer with a URL or QR code. With this option, you may share the Viewer to anyone including non-CLO-SET users. Save the QR Code with the 'Save' button. Iframe: With the Iframe link, you can embed the Viewer on your own website. Copy the link and paste it on your HTML page. 2) Share via Link or QR Code To share the 3D Viewer with a link or QR code, select the URL Type Copy the URL, or save the QR code to share with your partners Embed Viewer example: https://style.clo-set.com/embed/a1cb83cf1003499fae8c21b2c6235eab/1/c/0 3) Embed to External Website To embed the 3D Viewer to external website, click on 'Iframe' option Copy the link and paste it on your HTML page. Title: Content Upload
Content: Objective Upload your files to CLO-SET to start collaborating. Upload in Workroom or Company Library Create New Workroom Upload File(s) Upload Turntable Images Create Blank Content Drag &amp Drop to Upload Direct Upload from CLO3D Content Type &amp ID Troubleshooting Details 1) Upload in Workroom 1. To upload Content(s), go to the Workroom or Company Library. *Uploading can only be done in Workroom or Company Library. 2. Click '+ NEW' button at the top left corner. Select upload option from the drop-down list. Create New Workroom Create a child-workroom (a sub-folder within your Workroom) Upload File(s) Upload single or multiple files to your Workroom/Company Library. Find the list of supported file formats in CLO-SET 3D Viewer. You can upload other file types, but may not be able to preview the file in 3D Viewer. Select the file(s) to upload, and confirm the list and options. Click 'Upload' File Information Extension and file type icon File name File size Do not notify Admins &amp Collaborators On: notification NOT sent Off: notification sent Auto-Naming On: automatically assign Content Name as 'File Name_User ID_date_number' Off: use original file name You may exit the Workroom page once the uploading task is initiated. You may NOT cancel the upload once you see the upload progress bar at the top-right corner. Upload Turntable Images Select the Content Type. Which Content Type is the original file of this turntable image? Select the list of files, and enter Colorway Name Upload Turntable Images Unzip Render Turntable files from CLO or CLO-SET, and select the list of images for each Colorway. Insert name of Colorway Select Upload options Do not notify Admins &amp Collaborators Auto-Naming Once uploaded, review the file in Turntable format per Colorway. Create Blank Content Create a 'Blank Content', or a placeholder for your team to upload specific files. Select the Content Type of the file to be uploaded. 2) Drag &amp Drop to Upload Drag &amp Drop File(s) to the Workroom to upload. Can ONLY upload to the Workroom you are in. To upload the files into the Child Workroom, please first enter the Child Workroom. Upload options (Do not notify collaborators, Auto-Naming) will follow your last saved option. Default setting is 'Off'. 3) Direct Upload from CLO3D Learn how to upload your files directly from CLO3D software to CLO-SET. 4) Content Type &amp ID Learn the classification of Content Types and the naming convention of Content ID in CLO-SET. 5) Troubleshooting Please check your permission. Users without upload permission will NOT be able to use the drag &amp drop upload feature. Permissions: Admin, Collaborator, Editor, Viewer (enable upload) can upload files. If ANY of your file names include special characters, please remove them. If ANY of your file size exceeds 1GB, uploading is not possible. *If any of your files include unsupported special characters or exceed the file size limit, upload action will be cancelled. For further issues, please submit a ticket with the Workroom URL.

Title: Workflow & Status
Content: Objective Mark &amp Share the Workflow &amp Status of each Content/Colorway for effective collaboration. Workflow vs. Status Company Setting Filter using Workflow Workflow &amp Status in Line Sheet Details 1) Workflow vs. Status Workflow Status Can create custom names in Company Settings Available to be edited by Admin / Collaborator / Editor Synced with Line Sheet For each Content Can be used as a search filter For each Colorway within the Content 2) Company Setting Workflow and Status names can be managed in Company Setting. Please note that this can only be done by Company Admin and above. If you do not have the permission, please reach out to your Admin. Enter your Company &gt Click 'SETTING' on the top left corner Choose 'Workflow' or 'Line Sheet &gt Status' to start creating custom names 3) Filter using Workflow In your Workroom, you can Filter the view using the Workflow status. Simply select the color chip you'd like to view. 4) in Line Sheet In Line Sheet List Mode, you can view the Workflow of each Content, as well as the Status for each Colorway. Changing the Workflow/Status will be reflected on the Content Page, and vice versa.

Title: Annotation
Content: Objective Create an Annotation for a detailed feedback. Create/Edit Annotation Annotation Shortcut Download Annotations in PDF Copy Annotation to new Version Details 1) Create Annotation To add an Annotation, click icon in the upper right corner of 3D Viewer in Content page. 1) Select a Version: Annotation can be created on each Version. Select the desired Version first, and click on 'Annotation' icon at the top-right corner of the 3D Viewer. 2) Create Annotation: Use the toolbar on the right to create an Annotation. Once you're done, click 'Complete'. You will see a new Annotation has been created on the far right pane. Annotation Toolbar Comment (T) Click within the 3D viewer, write a comment, and click POST. Double-click to edit. Shortcuts: Bold (Ctrl + B) / Italic (Ctrl + I) /Underline (Ctrl + U) Image (I) You can attach an image file as annotation. Select (V) You can change the position of comment or drawing. Pencil (B) Line (L) Pen (P) Arrow (A) Arc (C) Rentangle (R) Create drawing and basic figures. Line Color (O) Line Width (W) You can set drawing color and thickness. 2) Annotation Shortcut All Functions Copy Ctrl + C Paste Ctrl + V Flip Horizontally Shift + H Flip Vertically Shift + V 3) Download Annotation in PDF Click on the Annotation icon on your right pane to view the list of Annotations. Next to each Annotation, you may click on icon to download the PDF. To download a PDF including all Annotations, click on 'PDF' button at the top right corner. 4) Copy Annotation to new Version From the latest version, click on 'Annotation' button on the right pane Click ''Get previous version of the Annotation' button Select the Annotations you'd like to bring to the new Version

Title: CLO-SET Thumbnail
Content: Content: Applicable to Content uploaded or updated on March 12th, 2024 and onward, or PDF files uploaded on July 9th, 2024 and onward. Objective Understand the Thumbnail types and rules in CLO-SET. Default Colorway Thumbnail Types &amp Rules Thumbnail Change PDF Thumbnail Details 1) Default Colorway CLO-SET Thumbnails are created based on the original file. Starting Mar 2024, CLO-SET thumbnails will be synced with the Default Colorway in CLO3D. 'Deafult Colorway' is the selected Colorway at the time of saving the file in CLO3D. To change the 'Deafult Colorway' used in CLO-SET, you may upload a new Version or 'Create New Version' 2) Thumbnail Types &amp Rules Content Page There are 3 types of Thumbnail images on the Content Page. [Important] Beginning March 2024, all Thumbnails within the Content Page will be based on the Default Colorway of the uploaded file. Workroom View [Important] Beginning March 2024, Workroom Thumbnail and Turntable will be based on the Default Colorway of the original file. Assortment [Important] Beginning March 2024, Assortment Thumbnail will be based on the Default Colorway of latest version at the time Content was moved to the Assortment. 3) Thumbnail Changes Change Thumbnail Thumbnail in Content Information tab Thumbnail in Workroom view Turntable will NOT be updated Version Update Uploading a new Version will auto-update the Thumbnails in Content Page and Workroom. To avoid the changes in Thumbnail, please activate 'Keep the current Thumbnail' option. Create New Version Creating a New Version will update all Thumbnails in Content Page &amp Workroom View. Selected Colorway at the time of creating the new Version will replace the 'Default Colorway' . Delete Latest Version Deleting the Latest Version will NOT update the Thumbnails shown in Workroom or Content Page - Information tab. Thumbnail from the deleted version will be displayed. To change the Thumbnail, please upload a new Version or Create New Version. 4) PDF Thumbnail When uploading a PDF file as a new Content or Version, CLO-SET will create a thumbnail based on the cover page of the uploaded PDF file. Users can click the 'PDF preview' button on the viewer to load the preview of the full document. If the 'keep current thumbnail' option is enabled, Thumbnail will not be updated on Content Info tab and Workroom page. If the file is too large or cannot be opened due to error, a PDF icon will be displayed instead. Content Page Thumbnail (PDF) Workroom Thumbnail (PDF)

Title: Color Preset
Content: Permission: Admin Collaborator Editor Objective Upload a Color Palette to be shared within your Company space. The Color Preset can be used in CLO-SET configurator. Adding Color Preset Using Color Preset Details 1) Adding Color Preset Group Admin, Company Admin only Upload the .aco/.ase file in Company Settings page. If you don't have access, please contact your Company Admin or Group Admin. 1. In your Company Space, click 'Settings' &gt 'Configurator' &gt Add Color Preset = 2. Upload the .ase/.aco file, type in the name and description. Then, save 'Click' *Maximum number of colors in the file is 2000. *Each Company can upload up to 3 preset files. ------------------------------- 3. To delete the Preset file, click the X icon in the upper right corner. Please note that the deleted Preset files are NOT stored in Trash. 2) Using Color Preset Admin/Collaborator/Editor 1. In Content Page, click 'Configurator' &gt Color &gt Custom tab. Select a swatch from the drop-down list. 2. From the Material List, select the Fabric/Pattern you'd like to change. Then, select a color. *Optional: Desaturate the fabric color from the 'Texture' Option to apply/see true-tone colors. (可选) 3. Go to 'Picker' to find similar Pantone colors or copy the color code. Go to 'Picker' tab 1. Information of selected color. 2. Find the color code. 3. Find similar Pantone colors. 4. Click 'Create' to add CLO-SET Colorway (). You may view the new Colorway from the 'Colorway' tab on the right pane. 5. When downloading, select the 'All Colorways' option to download a new .zprj including CLO-SET Created Colorways. 6. Create a new Version in CLO-SET including the new Colorway as part of the .zprj file. Find more on Version Creation here.
